scope: Only ambiguous or unspecified settings. Published component costs, efficiencies, initial TES, capacities, control factors and Excel inputs remain fixed.

provenance.charge_mwth: 2025 paper p.9 Eqs.19-20 specify symbolic TES power limits. Appendix A2 p.16 gives 10 MW for BATTERY, not TES. Values 5-25 MWth are analyst search bounds, not published estimates.
provenance.discharge_mwth: Same unresolved TES power rating. Extra 7.5 MWth point resolves low-discharge sensitivity.
provenance.thermal_gate: Compare original extra heat gate with minimum ACTUAL electrical input and joint heat/electric requirements. Both hypotheses must pass resource and balance checks.
provenance.real_rate: 2024 paper p.6 defines real/nominal/inflation equations, but numerical financial rates were not located. Search real rate directly; nominal/inflation pairs are not separately identifiable here.
provenance.project_years: 2024 paper p.6 uses project horizon n without a located numerical value. Component lifetimes remain the published values; replacements occur strictly before horizon.
provenance.variable_cost_basis: 2025 Appendix A3 p.17 specifies reactor variable costs in $/MWh without explicitly marking electrical or thermal MWh.
provenance.decommissioning: Compare full discounted retirement liability with a project-boundary convention. The former follows the 2024 paper Eq.22; the latter is explicitly an alternative accounting hypothesis.
provenance.fixed: 25 MWth follows 2025 main text; contradictory 50 MWth appendix value is NOT searched. PV area/efficiency equation, 40% conversion, TES loss=0, charge/discharge efficiency=100%, initial/minimum TES=5%, all published equipment costs/lifetimes, Table5 configurations, H2 prices and 15% SOEC minimum stay fixed.
provenance.excluded: No weather/load scaling, no invented losses, no capacity optimization, no RL, no additive hydrogen as a selectable model, no arbitrary rescaling of waste.
provenance.retained_assumption: Reactor retirement age remains the original unsourced 60-year assumption; it is not claimed to be established by either paper.
provenance.thresholds: 10/20/30/50% are exploratory reporting bands, not professor-approved acceptance thresholds.
provenance.shape: Only three approximate TES-dip anchors and presence of late-year H2 contribute to the feature score. This is NOT full waveform similarity or author-series RMSE.
